Summarize a fitted latent transition model

Source: R/transitions.R
summary.multilpa_transitions.Rd

Summarize a fitted latent transition model

Usage

# S3 method for class 'multilpa_transitions'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A fitted multilpa_transitions model.

...

Reserved for compatibility with summary().

Value

A summary_multilpa_transitions object carrying the measurement parameters, the initial and transition probabilities and counts, the effective class counts, the fit statistics and the restart diagnostics. Its tables are read with get_results(); print() reports the whole model.

See also

get_results() for the transition probabilities as a tidy table.

Examples

fit <- lta(subset(course_engagement, student <= 40),
           c("browse", "lectures", "forum_read"), "student",
           n_profiles = 2, time = "sequence", n_starts = 2, seed = 1)
summary(fit)
